SRJPEmodel

Functions and documentation for the Spring Run Juvenile Production Estimate (SRJPE) forecast model. Input data comes from the SRJPEdata package, and the forecast is run in runSRJPE.

The package currently contains the BT-SPAS-X juvenile abundance submodel and the functions for storing model fits. The stock-recruit, survival/travel-time, in-season and PLAD submodels are being developed in their own repositories and will be added back as they are finalized. Earlier versions of their code are in archive/ and at the tag legacy-pre-migration.

Installation 

# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("SRJPE/SRJPEmodel")

Submodels

  • BT-SPAS-X juvenile abundance
  • Stock-recruit, survival, in-season and PLAD: articles are superseded until their code is added back.
